gloss: to divert; to distract; to relieve (boredom, pain)

definitions.gloss: to divert (one's mind); to relieve (boredom, sadness, pain)
definitions.explanation: To take one's mind off something unpleasant by turning attention to something else, so that boredom, worry or pain is felt less.

examples.english: To take my mind off things with music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らす⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a book to relieve the boredom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らそう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She worked late every day, trying to keep her grief at bay.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らす: to take one's mind off things
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らす: to relieve boredom, kill time
- {寂|さび}しさ / ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らす: to keep loneliness / grief at bay
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らす: to distract oneself from pain

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: the feeling being relieved takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. The intransitive partner is ⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧ (⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧, to be distracted, feel better). ⟦{紛|まぎ}らわす→紛らわす：08206_magirawasu⟧ means the same as {紛|まぎ}らす and is equally common.
